meta.name: emil-design-eng
meta.description: This skill encodes Emil Kowalski's philosophy on UI polish, component design, animation decisions, and the invisible details that make software feel great.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 学习 UI 动效与细节打磨的设计哲学
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望提升软件界面的精致感和用户体验。
copy.tagline_en: Learn design philosophy for UI animation and polish
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to improve the polish and user experience of your software interfaces.

howto.what: 装配后,Claude 会按 Emil Kowalski 的设计理念来审查和修改 UI 代码:先判断动画是否必要,再给出缓动、时长、transform 等具体改动,并以“Before/After/Why”表格输出审查结果。
howto.when: 当用户请求审查或改进 UI 代码、讨论动画效果,或询问界面实现细节时触发。首次调用若没有具体问题,Claude 只回复一段介绍性文字。

say.text: 审查这段按钮动画,给出 Before/After 表格和建议。
say.note: 会按表格输出审查结果。

say.text: 这个模态框应该怎么设置缓动?
say.note: Claude 会按动画决策框架给出建议。

say.text: 用 Emil 的思路优化这个弹出框的 transform-origin。
say.note: Claude 会建议基于触发点缩放。

howto.what_en: Claude applies Emil Kowalski's design engineering philosophy to UI and animation: it evaluates whether an animation is needed, then recommends easing, duration, springs, and concrete CSS changes, presenting code reviews in a Before/After/Why table.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for UI/interface code review, animation advice, or implementation details. On first invocation without a specific question, Claude only replies with an intro message pointing to animations.dev.

say_en.text: Review this button animation and give a Before/After table.
What easing should this modal use?
Optimize this popover's transform-origin using Emil's approach.
